When the pass before the assist is so good that you can't help but appreciate it. Pre-assists are often overlooked, but sometimes are the key element in creating a goal. The Premier League has seen some outstanding pre-assists over the years, and these are some of the very best. Featuring passes from: Kevin de Bruyne, Mesut Ozil, Cole Palmer and more!
